title: Clothes and What We Wear
introduction: Name familiar clothes and describe their colours using simple sentences.
definition: Name familiar clothes and describe their colours using simple sentences.
rules: Name familiar clothes and describe their colours using simple sentences.

examples.question: What do you wear on your feet: shoes or hats?
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

examples.question: What do you wear on your head: a hat or socks?
steps: Read the prompt and choose the word that fits.

exercises.question: What do you wear on your feet: shoes or hats?
exercises.solution: Shoes cover and protect the feet; hats cover the head.

exercises.question: What do you wear on your head: a hat or socks?
exercises.solution: Choose the item worn on the head.

exercises.question: Complete: I wear a blue ___. (shirt or shirts)
exercises.solution: The article a requires a singular countable noun.

exercises.question: What do you wear under shoes: socks or gloves?
exercises.solution: Socks cover the feet inside shoes; gloves cover the hands.

exercises.question: Complete: These ___ my trousers.
exercises.solution: These and trousers are plural, so use are.

summary: Name familiar clothes and describe their colours using simple sentences.
